title: CrowdStrike reports Q2 revenue up 26% YoY to $1.47B, vs. $1.44B est., and forecasts FY 2027 revenue above estimates; CRWD jumps 9%+ after hours (Jake Bleiberg/Bloomberg)
summary: Jake Bleiberg / Bloomberg: CrowdStrike reports Q2 revenue up 26% YoY to $1.47B, vs. $1.44B est., and forecasts FY 2027 revenue above estimates; CRWD jumps 9%+ after hours — CrowdStrike Holdings Inc.'s stock rose Wednesday on a strong financial report that saw it forecast revenue figures for the full year …
